name: Cereal-legume intercropping

soft_risks.risk: Strong competition between the two crops for water and light can cut the yield of the main crop
soft_risks.mitigation: Use wider strip arrangements and a drought-tolerant legume, and conserve moisture with mulch first

mechanism: Two crops with different rooting depths and nitrogen habits share the field, adding a legume nitrogen source and more niches above and below ground.

region_variants.note: Strip arrangements are the common dryland form, chosen so the legume does not shade the cereal during grain fill.
